\section{Mathematical definition, support, and publication}

\subsection{Distinct identities and indices}

Let \(a\) identify one application generation. Let \(q\) identify one exact,
immutable, completed PTC transformed-product publication generation bound to
\(a\), its CAL parent, and one observation \(o\). Let \(g\) identify one
coefficient realization bound to \(q\). The logical coefficient index \(i\)
is an exact detector-time occurrence with stable identity
\(\boldsymbol\iota_i\). The symbol \(p\) is reserved for a consumer-owned
spatial/map index; it never denotes a PTC product.

Each \(q\) declares exactly one publication-unit tag and bounds: a complete
segment, a complete scan, or a bounded chunk wholly within one named
segment/scan and observation. A unit never crosses observation, application,
CAL-parent, segment/scan, or PTC-product-generation identity. The tagged unit
size is explicit in \(q\); this contract supplies no hidden size default.

\subsection{Exact support}

The coefficient support and normalization population are

\begin{equation}
 \mathcal D_{g,q}=\mathcal S^{\mathrm{coef}}_{g,q}
 =\mathcal S^{\mathrm{PTC,out}}_q .
 \label{eq:domain}
\end{equation}

They contain every and only exact occurrence in the completed output support
of \(q\). The population is finite, nonempty, and identity-unique. It may span
all detectors, groups, arrays, networks, and times present in that publication
unit; none silently defines a separate population. A singleton is valid.
An empty population has no family instance. Observations and publication
units are never pooled.

A required \(q\) is labeled complete only after all required components and
links for that unit are durable, as required by frozen SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5
requirement 072. This preserves the inherited atomic-output rule while
allowing each completed segment, scan, or bounded chunk to be published and
handed off independently. No coefficient handoff waits for unrelated
publication units or for the whole observation to finish.

\subsection{Uniform construction}

For finite nonempty \(\mathcal D_{g,q}\),

\begin{align}
 c_\star &\equiv 1,\qquad [c_\star]=1,\label{eq:constant}\\
 \widetilde\omega_i&=c_\star,\qquad
 i\in\mathcal D_{g,q},\label{eq:raw}\\
 m_g&=\frac{1}{|\mathcal D_{g,q}|}
       \sum_{j\in\mathcal D_{g,q}}\widetilde\omega_j=1,\label{eq:mean}\\
 \omega_i&=\mathcal N_{\rm mean1}
   (\widetilde\omega_i;\mathcal D_{g,q})
   \equiv\frac{\widetilde\omega_i}{m_g}=1.
 \label{eq:normalized}
\end{align}

The mean is a mathematical identity, not an instruction to execute a
population-wide floating-point reduction of stored ones. A conforming
realization may return exact unity analytically after the finite, nonempty
support fact is established. Changing the normalization rule changes the
family definition even though this family's result is one.

The family accepts no numerical parameter. A request carrying another
constant, including another positive constant whose scale would cancel, is
not an instance of this family and cannot be clipped, ignored, or normalized
into acceptance.

\subsection{Compact exact association}

Let \(R_q\) be the immutable authoritative target-support reference in
Equation~\ref{eq:domain}. Its identity, source, generation, scope, and digest
are structurally bound to \(q\), and

\begin{equation}
 \operatorname{resolve}(R_q)
 =\{\boldsymbol\iota_i:i\in\mathcal D_{g,q}\}.
 \label{eq:supportref}
\end{equation}

A compact scalar publication carries a distinct stored support reference
\(\widehat R_g\). Its membership fact is true only when the independently
checked \(\widehat R_g\) exactly identifies \(R_q\), including matching source,
generation, scope, and digest. Equation~\ref{eq:supportref} defines the target
association; \(\widehat R_g\) is evidence that the payload realizes it without
a copied member list. If a representation instead enumerates members, its
complete stored manifest \(M_g\) must satisfy

\begin{equation}
 M_g=\{(\boldsymbol\iota_i,1):i\in\mathcal D_{g,q}\}
 \quad\text{with each identity exactly once}.
 \label{eq:enumerated}
\end{equation}

A missing or conflicting authoritative \(R_q\) prevents structural
establishment. After \(R_q\) is valid, a wrong or mismatched stored
\(\widehat R_g\), or an omission, addition, or repetition in \(M_g\), is a
payload-membership false. An unavailable stored reference or enumeration
check is unknown; contradictory claims about that same stored fact are
conflict. Row order, shape, cardinality, detector label, coordinate equality,
or container position cannot replace exact identity.

Family identity, scalar value, unit, integrity, \(q\)-to-\(g\) compatibility,
and named permission are immutable shared facts. They may be evaluated once
for their declared scope. Each occurrence-level handoff remains logically
associated with those shared evaluations through exact references plus its
own \(i\in\operatorname{resolve}(R_q)\) and request identity. Neither the
coefficient array nor a separate full profile record must be materialized for
every occurrence.

\subsection{Consumer consequences}

At the JINC boundary, \(p\) is JINC's spatial index and

\begin{equation}
 w_{ip}=\kappa_{ip}\omega_i=\kappa_{ip}.
 \label{eq:jinc}
\end{equation}

This equality transfers no ownership of \(\kappa_{ip}\), its sign, or JINC
support.

For the already selected NOI design on an exact MAP-admitted contribution
population, \(p\) is the MAP spatial index, \(C_p\) is MAP's occurrence set for
that spatial index, and

\begin{equation}
 a_{pi}=G_{pi}\gamma_i=G_{pi},\qquad
 B_d=\sum_p\sum_{\substack{i\in C_p\\
             \operatorname{detector}(i)=d}}a_{pi}.
 \label{eq:noi}
\end{equation}

This does not define \(G_{pi}\), change MAP arithmetic, or alter the NOI
design law.

\subsection{Representation and publication conformance}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.25\linewidth}p{0.31\linewidth}p{0.35\linewidth}}
\toprule
Form or stage & Required evidence & Forbidden inference\\
\midrule
\endhead
Compact support reference & Structurally valid target \(R_q\), stored
\(\widehat R_g\), and an independent exact
identity/source/generation/scope/digest match between them. & Cardinality,
order, shape, or a numerical one cannot substitute; a wrong stored reference
is payload false, not a structural redefinition of \(R_q\).\\
Enumerated representation & Complete \(M_g\), every and only target identity,
each exactly once, plus scalar/unit/integrity facts. & Deduplication,
truncation, inferred members, or acceptance from matching length is
forbidden.\\
Shared fact evaluation & Immutable fact result, exact declared scope, source
and input identities, retained T/F/U/C causes, and a stable reference from
each logical handoff. & Sharing cannot widen scope or erase an
occurrence-specific membership/request result.\\
Publication completion & All required components and links for that \(q\) are
durable before complete status; required failure propagates. & A partial
chunk cannot be labeled complete, and incomplete status cannot be repaired by
unity.\\
Incremental handoff & A completed \(q\), its exact support and payload, and a
complete profile decision for the requested use. & Completion of other
segments, scans, chunks, or the whole observation is not a prerequisite.\\
Normalization evaluation & Finite nonempty support plus the exact registered
constant and operator establishes \(m_g=1\) analytically. & A literal
population reduction or per-member stored coefficient is not required.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
